The proposed improvement should have no significant impact upon the watershed; there are no unique wetlands, flood plain intrusions nor probable groundwater problems associated with and within the limits of the project. However, discussed in the following paragraphs are some of the probable impacts and positive interactions involved within the immediate local confines of the project.
The Lincoln Highway improvement should not disrupt any of the adjacent communities along the route. This is basically a widening and reconstruction project so no existing or proposed land uses will be divided or altered. In addition, there should be no isolation nor alteration of the surrounding environment and no access disruption to abutting properties.
The improvement of Lincoln Highway will require the use of some land which is presently dedicated to other purposes. Frontage land from Roosevelt School in Chicago Heights will be needed for right-of-way purposes.
The Roosevelt School property consists of slightly less than three (3) acres of land in Chicago Heights, Illinois. The property is located on the north side of Lincoln Highway and is two (2) blocks in length. The first block is between Franklin and Sunnyside Avenues, and the second block is between Sunnyside and Prairie Avenues (See Exhibit "10").
The amount of land to be acquired consists of a thirteen (13) foot wide by 271.5 foot long strip between Franklin Avenue and Sunnyside Avenue. The same dimensioned strip of land between Sunnyside Avenue and Prairie Avenue will also be acquired. A total of 8,790 square feet (0.20 acres) of land will be acquired from the Roosevelt School property.
During the development of this highway improvement proposal, four (4) schemes were developed which would vacate that segment of Sunnyside Avenue separating the school building from the playfield. Through early coordination procedures, the School District, the City of Chicago Heights and the Illinois Department of Transportation have reached an agreement to accept Scheme "A" for the Lincoln Highway improvement. (See Exhibit "11") Documentation of Correspondence between the involved parties is contained in Appendix "B".
